findings.description: Submitting an invalid expense (for example a negative amount, bypassing the browser's min attribute) returns HTTP 400 with the form re-rendered empty: there is no error message saying what was wrong and the title, category and amount the user typed are discarded.
repro: Observe a 400 page showing only an empty Add expense form, with no error text and none of the entered values kept

notes: Covered: list total (sum matches), category filter incl. totals, add/edit/delete as editor with reload, viewer read-only (no controls; direct GET/POST edit, add, delete refused with 403), unauthenticated redirects, bad login, validation. List, filter, add, edit and permission journeys behaved correctly. Not tested: browser-level a11y audit, visual layout at other viewport sizes.

cost.notes: estimate from 77178 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0154-$0.1852
